reviews.text: The business is very good🔥You need to wait a moment, the barbecue is delicious, the meat is better than the vegetables, the meat has a honey taste, the unit price of vegetables is low, it is very friendly to students, you can order a variety at one time.

Under the dim light of the oven, the chicken skin is like a piece of golden armor. After being baptized by the flames, it blooms with a crisp yet pliable luster. When you first take your mouth, the tips of your teeth touch the slightly crispy shell, and then a rich and delicious buttery aroma bursts out, like a gorgeous symphony playing on your taste buds.

The overlapping layers of oil are sublimated under the extreme heat of the roasting. It is neither greasy nor burdensome, but slowly blooms on the tip of the tongue in an almost dreamy way. It is as warm as silk and as gentle as the night wind. People can't help but hold their breath and savor it, fearing to miss any sweet aftertaste. With a little salt and pepper, it adds an extra layer of flavor - the salty and sweet flavors intertwine, making this little chicken skin instantly become the king of barbecue, unrivaled.

How can one not be intoxicated by such a delicacy? Every chew is the ultimate reward for the tip of the tongue, and every aftertaste is a deep tribute to the fireworks in the world. This is not just a snack at a barbecue stall, but also an ultimate taste feast, a grilled poem not to be missed.

After chatting with the boss, I found out that he has been selling here for five or six years. The meat and vegetables are roasted on site, drizzled with honey sauce and sprinkled with pepper and salt, which is very delicious.
The chicken thigh meat is very tender and juicy. In addition to being a late night snack, it is also suitable for taking in a lunch box the next day😁

Takeout sausages, rice sausages, pork blood cakes, chicken butts, chicken breasts, and cabbage for a total of $200. The buying method is a bit like picking up saltwater chicken, cutting it into pieces, and sprinkling pepper, salt, spices, and chili peppers, but it is not saltwater chicken flavor. The meat has been braised or grilled first, but the taste will not be as strong as braised food... It doesn’t have a particularly strong flavor, but I will buy it when I see it open. Maybe it’s because the stalls appear at the beginning.

If you haven’t studied at National Chengchi University, you must at least eat at this restaurant! Awesome!
Refreshing and unburdened~ Not like my studies^_^
